content:
id: nacos-default-login

info:
  name: Nacos Weak/Default Password Detection
  author: mbigfish
  severity: high
  description: >
    Nacos console allows login using default credentials `nacos:nacos`, which may lead to unauthorized access.
  reference:
    - https://blog.mbigfish.com
  classification:
    cwe-id: CWE-798
    cvss-score: 9.8
    cvss-metrics: CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: http.title:"Nacos"
  tags: nacos,weak-password,login,default-login

http:
  - method: POST
    path:
      - "{{BaseURL}}/nacos/v1/auth/users/login"

    headers:
      Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

    body: "username=nacos&password=nacos"

    matchers:
      - type: word
        part: body
        words:
          - "accessToken"
        condition: and

    matchers-condition: and

    extractors:
      - type: json
        part: body
        json:
          - ".accessToken"
params: "[{\"Field\":\"target\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"扫描目标\",\"Help\":\"扫描目标可接受：主机名 / 主机名:端口 / IP段 / URL 等多种格式\",\"Required\":true},{\"Field\":\"reverse-url\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"反连 URL\",\"Help\":\"可使用 InteractshURL 也可使用 Yakit Reverse URL\"},{\"Field\":\"debug\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"boolean\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"设置调试模式\",\"Help\":\"开启调试模式，调试模式将输出尽量多的调试信息\"},{\"Field\":\"proxy\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"proxy\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"HTTP 代理\",\"Help\":\"设置 HTTP 代理\"}]"
help: Nacos console allows login using default credentials
